dict.string: Vesper controls apps like Music when you ask her to — play, pause, skip.
Vesper reads your calendar when you ask about your day, and adds events you ask her to.
Vesper adds reminders you ask for and reads today's reminders when you ask about your day.
Vesper listens while you hold the push-to-talk shortcut, so you can talk to her.
Vesper looks at your screen when you talk to her, so she can see what you're asking about.
Vesper transcribes what you say on-device, so she can understand your question.
